title: China's grain exports, 1957–1962, in million tonnes
description: Bar chart, gross grain exports in million tonnes: 1957, 2.09; 1958, 2.89; 1959, 4.16; 1960, 2.72; 1961, 1.36; 1962, 1.03. Exports peaked in 1959, the first year of the famine. Data: China Statistical Yearbook 1981, as tabulated by Fan, Xiong and Zhou.
heading: GRAIN EXPORTS · MILLION TONNES
